title: 70s Paperback Studies
description: Nine independent 70s-era science-fiction paperback covers — each a different imagined title exploring airbrush planets, chrome-foil cursive lettering, and matte paperstock flatness, rendered at modern display precision.
creative_direction: Each cover is a standalone title in a fictional 70s sci-fi paperback line. Shared grammar: airbrush gradient skies, glossy planetary objects, chrome or foil title lettering, thin sans author line, slab-serif series tag, matte paper edge. No recurring character or planet between covers.
